entries.title: UMFT 20-Color Angular Spin-Polarization Vector Science
entries.markdown:
# 20-Color Pie (UMFT Scientific Vector Model)

Under Unified Multiversal Field Theory (UMFT), the 20 Colors around the Wheel represent **angular spin-polarization vectors** — strictly decoupled from Elements, Polarity, Morality, and Emotion.

- **5 Gold-Bordered Anchors**: `{W}` (0), `{U}` (4), `{B}` (8), `{R}` (12), `{G}` (16)
- **15 Bridge Vectors**: `{Iv}`, `{Cy}`, `{Az}`, `{In}`, `{Vi}`, `{Ob}`, `{Cr}`, `{Mg}`, `{Sc}`, `{Or}`, `{Am}`, `{Ch}`, `{Ja}`, `{Te}`, `{Aq}`
- **Layer 0**: Colorless `{C}`
- **Layer 2**: All 190 Option B Fused Pairs (Allied Anchors 5, Enemy Anchors 5, 180° Opposites 10, Anchor–Bridge 75, Bridge–Bridge 105)
- **Layer 20 Omnichroma `{Ω}`**: 6 bespoke sacred celestial geometries (`{Ω·M}`, `{Ω·C}`, `{Ω·S}`, `{Ω·V}`, `{Ω·E}`, `{Ω·A}`).

entries.title: Flagship Ultimate TCG (WIP Foundational System)
entries.markdown:
# Ultimate TCG (WIP / Extensible)

- **Non-Card Avatar**: 0 deck slots; lives on Multi-Avatar Accounts with persistent Levels, 3D Grid Stats, openly shown Sequential Flavor Filters (`1–85`, pure integers; `Xa` strictly for Gameplay Design), Aspect-Penalty off-flavor surcharges (`1a`), and dynamic Flavor Drift.
- **Deck Rules**: Deferred minimums, uncapped deck ceiling, **5-copy default** per card name (rules-text overrides allowed below or above 5), Main Deck (with Lands), Extra/Apex Deck, and **15+ Resource Sub-Decks**.
- **Board**: 2D Game Mat + Toggleable 3D Combat Positioning Grid, Hidden Standby Row (2–3), Combined World Zone (`[Magic]`/`[Force]`/`[Dual-Law]`/`[Extraversal Rift]` + Heart-Pocket Keyhole), 4 Turn Phases (`Draw -> Resource/Setup -> Action/Battle -> End`), LIFO Stack, 5–6 Shields, Project X Zone Frontline (3–5 cap, default 3, Pair + Solo, Cross Hit, 0%–150% XP Gauge), and Dual-Chamber Vitality (Magic Pulse & Force Pulse + Outsider toggle).
- **Strict Time-Travel Client Rule**: Match cards NEVER carry Filters 19–21. Only `End Turn` and `Extra Turn` temporal effects are permitted in match play.

entries.title: Notebook Duel Monsters & Hybrid Formats
entries.markdown:
# Notebook Duel Monsters Formats

All Notebook Formats run as non-locked rule sets while keeping `ProjectIgnis/EDOPro` strictly locked in its upstream base slot:

1. **Base Master Rule (Expanded)**: 5 Monster, 2 EMZ, **2 Dedicated Pendulum Zones (NOT inside S/T)**, 5 S/T, Field Spell, Skill Card(s), Soul Zone, Main (40–60), Extra (up to 15), GY, Banished.
2. **Yumi Muto Maximum-Power Hybrid Mat**: 5 Main Monster, 5 full S/T, 2 dedicated Pendulum, 1 Field, 1 EMZ.
3. **Turbo Duel (Base & Mario Kart Duel)**: Pre-Filled Field Spell + Speed Spell Zone (+ Character Zone & Item Zone up to 20 counters; Coin Box adds 1–6).
4. **Action Duel (Base & Mario Party Duel WIP)**: Base Master Rule + 3 Action Spell Zones.
5. **Speed Duel & Rush Duel (Base 3/3 & Updated 5/2 EMZ/5)** with dedicated Pendulum Zones and Soul Zone.

entries.title: Planet Cray Vanguard, Morphing Grid & Tokusatsu Tether

# Planet Cray & Universal Arena Hosting

- **Planet Cray Core**: 1 Vanguard + 5 Rear-Guards, Grade Riding, Soul-Stack, 6-Point Damage Zone, Counter-Blast, Drive/Trigger Checks, Hand-Blocking.
- **Opt-In Side-Project Formats Toggle**: Planar Reality Law Slot, Inverted Resonance Over-Riding, Triple-Pathway Rides, Adjacency Support.
- **Arena Hosting Modes**: Native Universe Match vs. Off-World Morphing Grid Battlefield (Polarity Insulation + Ludic Containment) vs. Out-of-Game Card Invocation (personal-mana echoes + Evocation Fading).
- **Tokusatsu Grid-Tether Modifiers**: 55a Secrecy, Duplicate-Color Interference vs. Multi-Color Megazord XP, Unaware vs. Aware Handshake risk.

entries.title: Memorial Forge & Dual-Channel Chat Separation
entries.markdown:
# Memorial Forge & Persistent World Rules

- **Strict Dual-Channel Separation**: **IC Chat** is the SOLE feed into the Memorial Forge. **OOC Normal** and **OOC Ruling-Call** logs are strictly separated.
- **Non-Automatic Global Pool Acquisition**: Legendary events are Event-Flagged and Player-Voted before entering the Full-Lifespan Memorial Forge.
- **Offline AI Two-Gate Authorization**: Gate 1 checks Native Intended Time on the Server-Synced Clock; Gate 2 requires Companion App Approval, Guardrails, Decline, or Live Drop-In.
- **Time-Travel & Causal Quarantine**: Filters 19–21 appear ONLY on Sovereign World-Walker Avatar profiles and Memorial Forge dossiers.
